official: 港区議会議員及び区長の選挙における選挙運動の公費負担に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案一覧

name: 選挙運動の公費負担限度額を引き上げ
summary: 現在の条例で定めている、港区議会議員選挙と区長選挙の選挙運動にかかる公費負担の限度額を引き上げます。改正後の額は、公布日以後に期日が告示される選挙から適用されます。
changes: 第6条・第8条の限度額を7円73銭から8円38銭に引き上げる
第11条の限度額を541円31銭から586円88銭に引き上げる
who: 港区議会議員選挙や区長選挙に立候補する人
why: 公職選挙法施行令の改正を踏まえ、公費負担の限度額を引き上げるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Raises public expense limits for election campaigning
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Public Expense Coverage for Election Campaigns in Elections for Minato City Assembly Members and Mayor
en.summary: Raises the limits on public expenses for election campaigning in Minato City Assembly elections and mayoral elections, as set by the current ordinance. The revised amounts apply to elections whose dates are officially announced on or after the ordinance is promulgated.
changes: Raises the limits in Articles 6 and 8 from ¥7.73 to ¥8.38
Raises the limit in Article 11 from ¥541.31 to ¥586.88
who: People running for election to the Minato City Assembly or for mayor
en.why: The ward says it is raising the public expense limits in response to an amendment to the Enforcement Order of the Public Offices Election Act.
